hammurabi-code-penalties.description: A large dark stone stele with a rounded top stands in a walled courtyard of tan brick with blue-glazed tile bands and arched doorways. The top carries a relief of a seated, horned-crowned figure facing a standing robed figure. Its face is covered in rows of small carved wedge-like marks. Torches burn at the sides, and a group of robed and spear-carrying people in the foreground gesture toward the stone under a dark, cloudy sky. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame.

newgate-prison-built.description: A dimly lit stone gatehouse with crenellated battlements and a tall corner tower, seen at night. A lantern hangs beside a dark arched passage, and a small barred window sits high on the wall. A small arched wooden door is set low on the left. Two figures in dark clothing, possibly guards, stand near the entrance on a wet cobbled street. The painting is an edge-to-edge dark oil style with no visible text or frame.

bridewell-house-of-correction.description: A woman in a headscarf and brown dress sits at a long wooden bench, holding a mallet raised and bent over a tangle of fibre. Behind her a bearded man in a dark doublet stands holding a staff. Other figures sit on benches working on fibres along the walls of a vaulted stone hall with a gothic arched window letting in a shaft of light, a carved stone fireplace and doorway on the right. The style is a dark oil painting. No visible text, no frame.

paris-lieutenant-general-police.description: A dim, narrow cobbled street at night, lined with half-timbered houses with shuttered windows. A man in a wide plumed hat and dark cloak strides forward holding a long staff, with a second man beside him holding a flaming torch. A group of men in broad hats and cloaks, some with pikes or staves, follows behind. A hanging iron lantern glows above, and smoke drifts through the upper street. No visible text or frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

bow-street-runners-formed.description: Two men in three-cornered hats and dark long coats grab a wild-haired young man in a loose shirt and waistcoat on a narrow cobbled street at night. One officer pins his arm and holds a short wooden cane; the other holds a pair of open handcuffs. Brick townhouses, a lit lantern on a post, iron railings and a dim sky fill the scene. Painterly, dark, oil-paint style, edge to edge with no visible text.

vidocq-founds-surete.description: A painting in a dark, candlelit office. A man in a dark frock coat, waistcoat and top hat leans over an open ledger on a wooden table. A ragged, shabby man in a cap cups his hand to the first man's ear as if whispering. The table holds stacks of papers, a box of index cards and a lit candle. A window with pale light is on the right, and a shadowy third figure stands at the far right edge. Small handwriting is on the papers, but it is not legible. No frame or border is visible.

last-public-hanging-england.description: A wooden gallows platform with a noose hanging from a crossbeam stands in front of a grey stone prison wall. A dense crowd of men in top hats and bowler hats, plus women in shawls and bonnets, watches from below in an overcast, smoky street. There is no visible text, frame or border, and no blood or violence.

bertillon-criminal-measurement.description: A dark, oil-painted interior. A seated bearded man in a dark suit has his head measured with steel calipers by a standing man in a waistcoat and white shirt with a watch chain. A wooden box camera sits on a tripod at left, and a desk at right holds papers with small photographs, brass instruments and a book. Light comes from a window at the far right.

first-electric-chair-execution.description: A heavy wooden chair with leather straps, a metal head cap hanging above it and thick cables running to the right, toward a dark panel with two round gauges and a row of switches. It stands empty in a dim room with rough stone walls, a dark wooden door, and a worn floor. The painting is oil-like and fills the whole square with no frame.

scotland-yard-fingerprint-bureau.description: A man in a dark three-piece suit with a moustache leans over a desk, peering through a brass magnifying glass at a sheet of inked fingerprints. A metal pen-like tool is in his other hand. Behind him are wooden filing cabinets with stacks of bound papers on top and shelves of tied folders. On the desk are a rolling ink slab, an ink pot with lid, a roller, and crumpled cloth. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with warm lamplight, and the image fills the full frame with no border.

wireless-catches-crippen.description: A young man in a dark suit and headphones works a brass telegraph key at a wooden desk in a cramped wood-panelled cabin. Behind him, an older man in a peaked cap with a badge leans in and watches. A sparking spark-gap transmitter with blue electric arcs stands in a glass-walled box, a glowing oil lantern sits on the desk, and a round porthole on the left shows a moonlit sea. Brass and wood equipment, a paper form and an ink bottle are on the desk. No visible text or frame; the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.

polygraph-invented.description: A seated man in a waistcoat and rolled white shirt has a cuff on his upper arm and a strap across his chest, with wires running to a brass-and-wood instrument with a rotating drum of paper and an inked wavering trace. A second man in a dark suit and tie leans in and watches him from the right. Dark, painterly background, oil-paint brushwork, no visible text.

first-gas-chamber-execution.description: A dim, painterly view of a riveted octagonal steel chamber with a round porthole window and a heavy wheel-latched door. Inside sits an empty wooden-and-metal chair with straps. Pipes, a pressure gauge and valves run up the right side. The chamber stands in a dark stone-walled room lit by a single overhead light. No people, no text.

first-911-call.description: A close-up painting in a dim, oil-paint style. A glossy red rotary telephone with a coiled red cord sits on a worn wooden desk. Behind it is a dark metal rack of panels with rows of rivets, switches and black cables plugged in. To the right sits a grey vintage radio with a speaker grille and a dial. A lamp glows at the far left edge. No visible text, frame or people.

first-lethal-injection-execution.description: A dim, painted interior of a tiled room with a white padded gurney as the central object. Thick brown leather straps hang from its arms, legs and torso, and a metal IV stand with coiled tubing stands behind it. A barred window sits in the upper left with a faint shadowy figure behind the bars. The walls are grey-green tile, stained and dirty, and the floor is dark. The style is loose oil painting, with no visible text, frame or wall-hung canvas.

dna-evidence-convicts-killer.description: A man in a white lab coat and gloves, seen from the chest up, holds up a translucent film printed with dark parallel horizontal bands and points at it with a gloved finger. Behind him a bright monitor or light box glows, and a shelf of bottles sits in the dark background. On the bench in front are a rack of small plastic sample tubes, a row of red-filled vials, pipettes and a flask with reddish liquid. The painting is an oil-style image with thick brushwork and fills the whole frame, with no visible text.

golden-state-killer-identified.description: A dark, painterly still life on a desk. An open silver laptop shows a branching tree of grey nodes and connecting lines on a pale screen. Beside it sit a small glass vial with a DNA helix shape, a brass magnifying glass, a sheet of handwritten paper with illegible scribbles, and a thick, worn stack of old case files with a blank label. No people are shown, and the painting runs edge to edge.
